independence: Independent linguistic review; no application/catalogue edits. Actual fallback model disclosed by session model-switch notice.

findings.description: The many branch renders "1000000 de conversaciones". With a numeric digit string rather than the noun millón/millones, the extra de is ungrammatical. Ordinary one/other counts are correct.
findings.recommendation: Remove de in the many branch when rendering the full numeric count, or render millón/millones as words with the appropriate number formatter.
findings.evidence: IntlMessageFormat(es message, es), count=1000000 => Quita esta etiqueta de 1000000 de conversaciones.

findings.description: Assignment removal uses Eliminar, the same verb as deleting a tag globally, while clear uses Quitar. The conversation-menu context prevents a blocking misunderstanding, but the distinction between removing a conversation assignment and deleting the tag entity is weaker than in English.
findings.recommendation: Use Quitar consistently for removing tag assignments (including the success toast and move description); retain Eliminar for deleting tag entities.
findings.evidence: chat-sidebar.tsx:6377-6386 invokes moveChatToTag(row, untagged) for remove_all; chat-tag-move.ts emits removed_all after assignSessionTags, not tag deletion.

findings.description: The V2-1 strings use Spanish angle quotation marks «…», while existing strings use curly double quotation marks “…”. Both are understandable; the namespace is typographically inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Use a single quotation style throughout the Spanish namespace, preferably «…».

checks.coverage: Read and compared all 54 English/Spanish pairs, including all 12 V2-1 keys; checked meaning, informal tú register, grammar, plurals, interpolation, typography, movement, assignment removal, Undo, Untagged and changed-elsewhere semantics. No English-fallback substitutions accepted.
checks.icu: Executed @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and IntlMessageFormat across all 54 messages; identical key and argument sets, all messages parsed/formatted. Exercised delete_description and remove_all at count 0, 1, 2, 1000000.
checks.register: Informal tú imperatives are consistent (Haz, elige, pulsa, Crea, Inténtalo, Aplica); infinitive action labels do not conflict.

checks.limitations: Linguistic and ICU audit only, not a rendered layout or independent application-flow QA pass.
